data.explanation: The Zentrale Bußgeldstelle Musterland (central fine office) says you drove 23 km/h over the speed limit and wants €98.50 (fine, fee and expenses) plus 1 point in the driving register. You may decide whether to accept this or file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or in person at the office; the app shows the deadline for that. If you do nothing by then, the notice becomes final and can be enforced, and payment of the total amount becomes due afterwards. If you think the measurement is wrong or want to dispute it, consider getting advice (e.g. from a traffic lawyer) before the deadline shown.

items.title: Decide whether to file an objection (Einspruch)
items.action: Decide whether to accept the fine or file a written objection (Einspruch), or declare it to the record (zur Niederschrift) at the Zentrale Bußgeldstelle Musterland, by the deadline shown.
items.consequence: If no objection is filed in time, the notice becomes final (rechtskräftig) and can be enforced, and the 1 point is entered in the Fahreignungsregister.
items.quote: Frist: zwei Wochen nach dem Tag der Zustellung.

date.text: zwei Wochen nach dem Tag der Zustellung

items.action: Once the notice is final, pay the total of €98.50 by bank transfer to the given account, using the Aktenzeichen as payment reference.
items.consequence: If not paid, the amount may be collected by enforcement (Vollstreckung).
items.quote: Gesamtbetrag binnen zwei Wochen ab Rechtskraft auf das unten angegebene Konto (Verwendungszweck: Aktenzeichen).

data.summary: The Zentrale Bußgeldstelle Musterland (central fine office) issued a Bußgeldbescheid to David Muster for speeding 23 km/h over the limit on 27 August 2025 near Neu-Musterdorf, with a total of €98.50 due and 1 point entered in the Fahreignungsregister. The letter was formally delivered (Zustellungsurkunde) on 19 September 2025, starting a two-week objection (Einspruch) period.
